ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: MUSICAL BIOGRAPHY This seminar will consider a series of historiographical and conceptual issues relating to the writing of musical biographies - whether of composers, performers or the less celebrated figures in music history, such as impresarios or critics. To this end we will read and critique a number of musical biographies from a range of historical periods. Topics for consideration will include: the role and interpretation of source material (including oral testimony), the interrelationship of life and work, the creation of narrative, and the translation of musical lives into film.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
